summary: Conversations with images restore from the external cache
compatibility: Needs vllm #904. Text checkpoints keep their existing names.
details: Checkpoint names were built from token IDs only, and every image has the same placeholder IDs, so conversations with images were never stored externally. After eviction from GPU memory or a restart, one image at the start of a chat made every turn compute the whole conversation again.

Placeholder spans are now named by the image's content hash and the vision precision setting. In our restart test, two conversations with the same 15K-token text and different images restored 15,410 and 15,429 tokens and both named their own image correctly; before, 0 tokens were restored.
